amendment.reason: P1 v1 found exact local non-identifiability between two freely estimated background-shape coefficients under per-profile max normalization. V9 background_variation is frozen at zero, so its polynomial shape is deterministic; v2 fixes that shape and estimates only amplitude. No numerical Gate threshold was changed.

scope: single public BaTiO3 P4mm CIF; conditional du,dv interpolation; synthetic measurements only

source.historical_citation: Shirane et al., Phys. Rev. 105, 856 (1957), DOI 10.1103/PhysRev.105.856

forward.q_units: dimensionless normalized log-lattice coordinates mapped to a,c in angstrom
nuisance_units: relative to reference clean peak height
forward.noise_model: Poisson count noise plus Gaussian readout before per-profile max normalization

v9_view.name: v9_four_perturbations
v9_view.background_shape: fixed deterministic V9 nonnegative quadratic polynomial, variation 0, floor fraction 0.10; only its amplitude is estimated

training.method_b: parameter MSE plus differentiable expected measurement-profile MSE
training.lambda_selection: lowest validation normalized-q MAE; ties choose smaller lambda; test is never used
training.lambda_selection_scope: lowest mean validation normalized-q MAE across the three paired seed runs within each measurement condition
training.rng_seed_policy: same paired seed for A/B and simple/V9; q split is frozen before measurement views are generated
training.nuisance_truth_policy: generation/metadata/oracle diagnostics only; the non-oracle B training and inference loss receives predicted eta and observed profile only
